descriptionPlain:
Overview
Lightship is the first American all-electric recreational vehicle manufacturer currently developing an aerodynamic, battery-powered trailer for the electric age. As the macro transition to an all-electric transportation ecosystem accelerates, Lightship is bringing the increased convenience and superior performance that electrification offers to a pastime enjoyed by over 11 million American families.
 
Honoring Diverse Perspectives
Lightship is committed to hiring and developing top talent from diverse backgrounds. We believe representing and supporting diverse groups is key to the success of our team members, customers, shareholders and the achievement of our mission and vision. We operate in a collaborative environment with a flat organizational structure and expect a high degree of integrity, autonomy and creativity from all members of the team.


About the Role:

lists.content:
• Design and build engaging applications in Android and iOS platforms.
  • Work closely with backend developers to integrate APIs, third-party libraries, and cloud services (like Firebase) to ensure seamless data flow and functionality.
  • Collaborate with our third-party development team on new features and releases.
  • Develop, maintain, and extend cloud server applications and infrastructure.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Proficiency developing with Kotlin for Android
  • Proficiency with using tools like Figma for Ux design and mockups
  • Experience using Flutter for cross-platform application development
  • Experience with UI design and reactive UI patterns

lists.content:

  • Maintain the full vehicle wiring diagram with support from the power systems and vehicle engineering teams
  • Manage high-voltage harness routing and design for the drive system, power distribution, and HVAC

• B.S. or higher degree in an engineering field, preferably Mechanical Engineering
